insight: Emerged from stealth in April 2024 with a $227M Series B at a $977M valuation, led by Sutter Hill Ventures.
name: Augment Code
tagline: Agentic coding assistant tuned for large, multi-repo codebases.
description: Augment Code is an AI coding platform whose Context Engine indexes large, multi-repo codebases so its completions, chat, and agents reason across cross-file dependencies. It runs as a VS Code and JetBrains extension, a CLI, and asynchronous remote agents, and targets engineering teams working in enterprise-scale repositories.

modelSupport.notes: Frontier models selectable; no key required on paid plans.

edge: Context Engine indexes entire multi-repo codebases — built for enterprise monorepos, not single-project editing.
pros: VS Code, JetBrains, CLI, remote agents
